name: Gradient-based Pre-computed Shading
definition: Pre-computes a shading volume (SHADING) from the CT density volume (CT) by calculating the surface normal via central finite differences and applying a diffuse lighting model. This avoids per-ray normal computation during rendering.
summary: Gradient-based Pre-computed Shading is a preprocessing technique that stores view-independent Lambertian shading in a volume, avoiding per-ray lighting calculations by operating directly on the voxel grid.
